basic_details.job_title: Mizoram PSC Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: MPSC is recruiting 2 Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics posts with Graduate (Arts/Commerce/Science) qualification, last date 28 August 2026.

application_fee.details: Persons with disabilities are exempted from payment of application fees. Fees once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances. If payment is to be done through UPI, it may be done using only the mobile number used by the candidate for one-time registration. Exact fee amount is as displayed on the online portal during application.

age_limit.details: A candidate must not be less than 18 years and not more than 30 years of age on 1st August, 2026. Upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years in case of ST/SC candidates or as may be notified by the Government from time to time. For proof of age, HSLC/HSSLC Certificates / Voters ID / Digitised Birth Certificate which clearly shows the candidate’s date of birth shall be accepted. (Details: https://tinyurl.com/age-relaxa)

qualification.details: Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the relevant cut-off dates. Only candidates who meet educational, physical, computer proficiency, Mizo language proficiency and age criteria are eligible. Documentary support to prove fulfilment of eligibility conditions should not be dated later than the last date for submission of application.
qualification.education_qualification: Graduate in Arts, Commerce & Science or its equivalent from any recognised University.
qualification.nationality: Must satisfy all conditions of eligibility as per notification. Government servants to apply through proper channel.

selection_process: Selection will be based on Written Examination and Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Candidates must meet the prescribed physical standards and qualify in the PET events. Physical measurement shall be conducted before the Physical Efficiency Test.
Syllabus: Available for download on the Commission’s official website – Notification No.A.12032/1/2022-MPSC(DR) dated 27th May
how_to_apply: Candidates shall apply online; no other mode of application will be accepted. Probable applicants who have not registered in the one-time-registration portal must register and submit their application well in advance before the last date of submission.
An applicant must verify that his/her application is actually submitted after payment is made, otherwise the claim of the applicant regarding his/her candidature will not be entertained.
Mandatory Documents to be uploaded (before last date):
Educational Certificates of HSLC and above
Proof of proficiency in Mizo Language
Any other relevant documents in the “Others” field
For queries: MPSC Helpline No. 0389-3596493 on working days between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM. Applicants can also approach the MPSC on all working days during office hours.
important_instructions: Candidates interested in this recruitment can also explore other Graduate Government Jobs and Bachelor's Degree Government Jobs available across India. Those seeking state-level opportunities can check the latest Mizoram Government Jobs and other Northeast India Government Jobs. Aspirants looking for uniformed service careers may also browse the latest Police Jobs, Excise Department Jobs, and Group B Non-Gazetted Jobs currently available in various government departments.

content_sections.heading: MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 (two) posts have been announced for the post of Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics under the Excise & Narcotics Department, Government of Mizoram. The number of posts is provisional and may vary according to the actual requirement. Reservation benefits (if any) will be as per Government of Mizoram norms for SC/ST candidates.

content_sections.heading: MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the relevant cut-off dates. Only candidates who meet educational, physical, computer proficiency, Mizo language proficiency and age criteria are eligible. Documentary support to prove fulfilment of eligibility conditions should not be dated later than the last date for submission of application.

rows.details: Graduate in Arts, Commerce & Science or its equivalent from any recognised University.
Male: Height 156 cms; Chest Normal 77 cms, Expanded 82 cms. Female: Height 150 cms; Chest Normal 72 cms, Expanded 74 cms.
As prescribed by the Mizoram Group ‘A’, ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts Service/Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2023. (Details: https://tinyurl.com/comp-proficiency)

Must achieve pass mark in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency. Exempted if studied Mizo subject in Class-X (HSLC) or above within Mizoram or opted for Mizo as MIL outside Mizoram. (Details: https://tinyurl.com/mizo-language-proficiency)
Must satisfy all conditions of eligibility as per notification. Government servants to apply through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on Written Examination and Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Candidates must meet the prescribed physical standards and qualify in the PET events. Physical measurement shall be conducted before the Physical Efficiency Test. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Standards Syllabus: Available for download on the Commission’s official website – Notification No.A.12032/1/2022-MPSC(DR) dated 27th May, 2025 (1. General Competitive Examination). Link: https://tinyurl.com/Slexcise

content_sections.heading: Who should NOT apply for MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates who do not possess a Graduate degree in Arts, Commerce & Science or its equivalent from a recognised University. Candidates outside the age band 18–30 years as on 01-08-2026 (except notified relaxations for SC/ST). Candidates who fail to meet the prescribed Physical Measurement standards (Height & Chest). Candidates unable to qualify the minimum standards in the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) events. Candidates without the required Computer Proficiency as per Mizoram Group ‘A’, ‘B’ & ‘C’ posts Rules, 2023. Candidates who do not possess Mizo Language Proficiency (and are not exempted). Candidates who fail to upload all mandatory documents by the closing date. Candidates who attempt canvassing directly or indirectly. Government servants who do not apply through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shall apply online; no other mode of application will be accepted. Probable applicants who have not registered in the one-time-registration portal must register and submit their application well in advance before the last date of submission. An applicant must verify that his/her application is actually submitted after payment is made, otherwise the claim of the applicant regarding his/her candidature will not be entertained. Mandatory Documents to be uploaded (before last date): Marksheets of HSLC and above Educational Certificates of HSLC and above Proof of Computer Proficiency Proof of proficiency in Mizo Language SC/ST Certificate (for SC/ST candidates only) Proof of date of birth Graduation certificate and complete marksheets Any other relevant documents in the “Others” field For queries: MPSC Helpline No. 0389-3596493 on working days between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM. Applicants can also approach the MPSC on all working days during office hours.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 28 August 2026 upto 4:00 PM through https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 (two) posts of Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics under the Excise & Narcotics Department.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification for MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate in Arts, Commerce & Science or its equivalent from any recognised University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 to 30 years as on 1st August 2026. SC/ST candidates get 5 years upper age relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. Is Physical Efficiency Test (PET) mandatory for MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must qualify the prescribed PET events (100m/800m/400m race, High Jump and Long Jump) as per male/female standards.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics in Mizoram?
faq.answer: The post carries Level – 7 in the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q7. Is Mizo language proficiency required for MPSC Sub-Inspector of Excise post?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must pass the Mizo Language Proficiency test unless exempted (studied Mizo in HSLC or above within Mizoram or as MIL outside Mizoram).
